notes.title: [Regular Update] Browser Extension Optimization & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Update Content[/h1]  
[h3]Optimized Browser Page[/h3]  
Added direct navigation from the browser plugin page to plugin-parsed websites (previously possible but unstable due to plugin issues). Added corresponding prompts when no plugin is detected.  
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100227/d08e42bdf18de85153eb05f638f1551ca0f5394b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100227/999a75206925e9c8072840ca6ac1005687aaea76.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100227/473cd6f8a73b5a16aa11d2f82b9b418f133c7ef3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100227/f9a4709f03397240695fcd5151017a0a8be28499.png[/img][/url]  
[h3]Added Error Prompts[/h3]  
- Added error prompts for failed asset submissions  
- Added error prompts for image retrieval failures via plugins  

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]  
1. Fixed an issue where video previews appeared black during asset uploads  
2. Fixed the ineffectiveness of default image/video display selection  
3. Fixed missing two images during plugin-based image retrieval  
4. Fixed an issue where the upload button only allowed file selection (not folders) when the default upload method was set to "Upload Folder"  

[h1]Plugin Updates[/h1]  
UE Store has been renamed to Fab Store. Due to frequent format changes in Fab Store, plugin support may not be fully stable. Please report issues via the discussion board or email bridgecave@163.com.  

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]  
[h3]Dark Theme Update Postponed[/h3]  
Custom styling support is planned, and dark theme updates will be incorporated into this feature.  
[h3]Short-Term Roadmap[/h3]  
1. Support asset sorting by "Last Accessed Time/Access Count/Added Time"  
2. Prioritizing one of three major updates:  
   - "Network Access Support"  
   - "Custom Styling Support (Global/Asset-Specific)"  
   - "Asset Categorization Support"

notes.title: [Bug Fix] Fixed Folder Upload Failure Issue
notes.content:
Emergency fix for the bug causing upload failure when selecting "Upload Folder" to import assets.

The browser extension has been upgraded to v1.1.4 (available after passing browser store review).
The latest extension now supports product page parsing for: Unity Store, UE Store, Itch.io, Sketchfab, CGTrader, Daz3D, RenderHub, and ArtStation.

The browser extension interface is still under optimization and will be completed soon.

notes.title: 【Update Notice】Bug Fixes & New Version Preview!
notes.content:
Dear User,
Thank you for your continued support! We’ve recently completed user experience optimizations and will launch our first content update in two weeks, bringing you more powerful creative support!

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
Fixed an issue where the page failed to redirect automatically after asset uploads. Now, upon completing the upload process, the system will automatically redirect you to the appropriate page, allowing you to seamlessly proceed with other operations or manage newly added assets.

[h1][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h1]
Over the next two weeks, we’ll roll out a series of exciting new features and improvements:
[list]
[*][b]Multi-Website Support Expansion[/b]: To broaden our service coverage, we’ll add support for five major platforms (ArtStation | Daz 3D | RenderHub | CGTrader | Sketchfab). This update will enable smoother resource imports from these sites to your local library, significantly expanding your asset options.
[*][b]Dark Theme Implementation[/b]: Based on user feedback, we’re developing a new dark theme interface. This feature not only reduces eye strain during prolonged computer use but also provides a more comfortable visual environment for night-mode enthusiasts.
[*][b]Browser Extension Page Optimization[/b]: We’ve refined our browser extension interface to enhance efficiency. The redesigned layout improves user experience, making asset searches, browsing, and imports more intuitive.
[/list]

[h1][b]【Co-Creation Initiative】[/b][/h1]
We believe great tools are shaped by developers together! If you’d like to:
[list]
[*] Request support for specific websites/browsers
[*] Propose new feature directions
[*] Report localization translation issues
[/list]
Visit our Steam Discussion Board to engage directly with us – every developer’s input will receive a tailored response!

Thank you for your ongoing trust and support of Local Asset Library!
The Local Asset Library Team
